notes.title: iREC price and publisher changes
notes.content:
Hello dear players,

Since the publisher of game is changed, we are looking to make iREC paid again

This changes should be done on the middle of October

Thanks all for support and feedback!

notes.title: FREE
notes.content:
Hello people
IREC is available to all
Good luck

notes.title: Fixed
notes.content:
Hi dear players,

We are monitoring your comments in the forums and made some minor corrections in the game to correct your problems. This update fixes the initial low resolution and other minor errors (we will keep updating any reported errors) .thanks!
